_comment: Token + run ledger by month. Builder checks the current month against monthly_token_cap.

last_run.reason: Job A round 3 — laser-hair-removal, lip-filler and microneedling cities, plus a market-structure study on coolsculpting. Four parallel agents (one died mid-run to an API error; its cities were not covered).
last_run.prices_found: 3 more real published prices (Elixir dermal-fillers $750 / microneedling $400; Health & Beauty Family dermal-fillers $400)

coolsculpting_study.verdict: structurally thin — CoolSculpting survives mainly in dermatology practices and national chains, not independent med spas, which have re-tooled to Emsculpt/Emsculpt Neo, Morpheus8, Evolve, VelaShape and GLP-1s.
coolsculpting_study.hit_rate: south-beach 1/10, coral-gables 1/9, kendall 2/10, pembroke-pines 3/10 clinics name CoolSculpting on their own site
confirmed_providers: Dr. Jhonny A. Salomon (Coral Gables/S Miami) 4.7/527
coolsculpting_study.recommendation: demote coolsculpting, promote morpheus8 — morpheus8 appeared at clinics in all four tested cities and clears the buildable threshold where coolsculpting does not. Config change is HARD-GATED; operator decision.

last_run.note_on_counts: one-short total rose 26 -> 30 because new clinics introduced hydrafacial/chemical-peel into cities that previously had none. Those are new opportunities, not regressions.
